perform: PERFORM SET-MAX-DAY IF WS-DAY >= 1 AND WS-DAY <= WS-MAX-DAY MOVE 'Y' TO WS-DATE-VALID END-IF END-IF END-IF
PERFORM CHECK-LEAP-YEAR IF WS-LEAP = 'Y' MOVE 29 TO WS-MAX-DAY ELSE MOVE 28 TO WS-MAX-DAY END-IF END-EVALUATE
write: WRITE-ERROR ELSE MOVE PI-EXPIRY-DATE TO WS-DATE-IN PERFORM VALIDATE-CALENDAR-DATE IF WS-DATE-VALID NOT = 'Y' MOVE 'S002' TO ER-CODE MOVE 'INVALID POLICY EXPIRY DATE' TO ER-MESSAGE PERFORM WRITE-ERROR ELSE IF PI-EXPIRY-DATE < PI-EFFECTIVE-DATE MOVE 'S003' TO ER-CODE MOVE 'EXPIRY DATE BEFORE EFFECTIVE DATE' TO ER-MESSAGE PERFORM WRITE-ERROR ELSE PERFORM DETERMINE-STATUS PERFORM WRITE-POLICY END-IF END-IF END-IF
WRITE PO-REC IF WS-PO-ST = '00' ADD 1 TO WS-WRITTEN ELSE DISPLAY 'POLICY OUTPUT WRITE ERROR ' WS-PO-ST ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE END-IF
WRITE ER-REC IF WS-ER-ST = '00' ADD 1 TO WS-REJECTED ELSE DISPLAY 'ERROR OUTPUT WRITE ERROR ' WS-ER-ST ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE END-IF
move: MOVE PI-REC TO PO-REC IF PI-POLICY-STATUS = 'CN' MOVE 'CN' TO PO-POLICY-STATUS ADD 1 TO WS-CANCELLED ELSE IF WS-CURRENT-DATE < PI-EFFECTIVE-DATE MOVE 'PN' TO PO-POLICY-STATUS ADD 1 TO WS-PENDING ELSE IF WS-CURRENT-DATE <= PI-EXPIRY-DATE MOVE 'AC' TO PO-POLICY-STATUS ADD 1 TO WS-ACTIVE ELSE MOVE 'EX' TO PO-POLICY-STATUS ADD 1 TO WS-EXPIRED END-IF END-IF END-IF IF PO-POLICY-STATUS NOT = PI-POLICY-STATUS ADD 1 TO WS-CHANGED MOVE WS-CURRENT-DATE TO PO-UPDATE-DT END-IF
MOVE PI-POLICY-NO TO ER-POLICY-NO WRITE ER-REC IF WS-ER-ST = '00' ADD 1 TO WS-REJECTED ELSE DISPLAY 'ERROR OUTPUT WRITE ERROR ' WS-ER-ST ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE END-IF

MOVE 'N' TO WS-PI-OPEN END-IF END-IF IF WS-PO-OPEN = 'Y' CLOSE POLICY-OUT IF WS-PO-ST NOT = '00' DISPLAY 'POLICY OUTPUT CLOSE ERROR ' WS-PO-ST ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE ELSE MOVE 'N' TO WS-PO-OPEN END-IF END-IF IF WS-ER-OPEN = 'Y' CLOSE ERROR-OUT IF WS-ER-ST NOT = '00' DISPLAY 'ERROR OUTPUT CLOSE ERROR ' WS-ER-ST ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE ELSE MOVE 'N' TO WS-ER-OPEN END-IF END-IF

MOVE 'N' TO WS-DATE-VALID IF WS-DATE-IN NUMERIC MOVE WS-DATE-IN(1:4) TO WS-YEAR MOVE WS-DATE-IN(5:2) TO WS-MONTH MOVE WS-DATE-IN(7:2) TO WS-DAY IF WS-YEAR > ZERO AND WS-MONTH >= 1 AND WS-MONTH <= 12 PERFORM SET-MAX-DAY IF WS-DAY >= 1 AND WS-DAY <= WS-MAX-DAY MOVE 'Y' TO WS-DATE-VALID END-IF END-IF END-IF
MOVE 31 TO WS-MAX-DAY WHEN 4 WHEN 6 WHEN 9 WHEN 11 MOVE 30 TO WS-MAX-DAY WHEN 2 PERFORM CHECK-LEAP-YEAR IF WS-LEAP = 'Y' MOVE 29 TO WS-MAX-DAY ELSE MOVE 28 TO WS-MAX-DAY END-IF END-EVALUATE

MOVE 'N' TO WS-LEAP COMPUTE WS-REM4 = FUNCTION MOD(WS-YEAR, 4) COMPUTE WS-REM100 = FUNCTION MOD(WS-YEAR, 100) COMPUTE WS-REM400 = FUNCTION MOD(WS-YEAR, 400) IF WS-REM400 = ZERO MOVE 'Y' TO WS-LEAP ELSE IF WS-REM4 = ZERO AND WS-REM100 NOT = ZERO MOVE 'Y' TO WS-LEAP END-IF END-IF
display: DISPLAY 'POLICY OUTPUT WRITE ERROR ' WS-PO-ST ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE END-IF
DISPLAY 'ERROR OUTPUT WRITE ERROR ' WS-ER-ST ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE END-IF
if: IF EXISTING STATUS = CN, PRESERVE CN
IF OPEN INPUT POLICY-IN IF WS-PI-ST = '00'
IF OPEN OUTPUT POLICY-OUT IF WS-PO-ST = '00'
IF OPEN OUTPUT ERROR-OUT IF WS-ER-ST = '00'
IF PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-FILE OR FATAL-ERROR
IF WS-PI-OPEN = 'Y' CLOSE POLICY-IN IF WS-PI-ST NOT = '00'
IF END-IF IF WS-PO-OPEN = 'Y' CLOSE POLICY-OUT IF WS-PO-ST NOT = '00'
IF END-IF IF WS-ER-OPEN = 'Y' CLOSE ERROR-OUT IF WS-ER-ST NOT = '00'
IF WS-YEAR > ZERO AND WS-MONTH >= 1 AND WS-MONTH <= 12
IF WS-REM4 = ZERO AND WS-REM100 NOT = ZERO
add: ADD 1 TO WS-CANCELLED ELSE IF WS-CURRENT-DATE < PI-EFFECTIVE-DATE MOVE 'PN' TO PO-POLICY-STATUS ADD 1 TO WS-PENDING ELSE IF WS-CURRENT-DATE <= PI-EXPIRY-DATE MOVE 'AC' TO PO-POLICY-STATUS ADD 1 TO WS-ACTIVE ELSE MOVE 'EX' TO PO-POLICY-STATUS ADD 1 TO WS-EXPIRED END-IF END-IF END-IF IF PO-POLICY-STATUS NOT = PI-POLICY-STATUS ADD 1 TO WS-CHANGED MOVE WS-CURRENT-DATE TO PO-UPDATE-DT END-IF
ADD 1 TO WS-WRITTEN ELSE DISPLAY 'POLICY OUTPUT WRITE ERROR ' WS-PO-ST ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE END-IF
ADD 1 TO WS-REJECTED ELSE DISPLAY 'ERROR OUTPUT WRITE ERROR ' WS-ER-ST ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE END-IF

ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE ELSE MOVE 'N' TO WS-PI-OPEN END-IF END-IF IF WS-PO-OPEN = 'Y' CLOSE POLICY-OUT IF WS-PO-ST NOT = '00' DISPLAY 'POLICY OUTPUT CLOSE ERROR ' WS-PO-ST ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE ELSE MOVE 'N' TO WS-PO-OPEN END-IF END-IF IF WS-ER-OPEN = 'Y' CLOSE ERROR-OUT IF WS-ER-ST NOT = '00' DISPLAY 'ERROR OUTPUT CLOSE ERROR ' WS-ER-ST ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE ELSE MOVE 'N' TO WS-ER-OPEN END-IF END-IF

conditions: WS-PI-OPEN = 'Y' CLOSE POLICY-IN IF WS-PI-ST NOT = '00'
END-IF IF WS-PO-OPEN = 'Y' CLOSE POLICY-OUT IF WS-PO-ST NOT = '00'
END-IF IF WS-ER-OPEN = 'Y' CLOSE ERROR-OUT IF WS-ER-ST NOT = '00'
WS-YEAR > ZERO AND WS-MONTH >= 1 AND WS-MONTH <= 12
WS-REM4 = ZERO AND WS-REM100 NOT = ZERO
